name: WAHA Heroku
description: WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API) on Heroku — NOWEB (Baileys) engine. React to channel posts via REST API.

WHATSAPP_DEFAULT_ENGINE.description: WAHA engine. NOWEB = Baileys (no browser, supports channels).

WAHA_API_KEY.description: API key sent as the X-Api-Key header. Keep it secret — never put it in the repo.

WHATSAPP_RESTART_ALL_SESSIONS.description: Restart stopped sessions after a dyno restart.

WAHA_PRINT_QR.description: Print QR in logs. False = pair from the dashboard instead.
